latest_release.name: raylib v6.2
latest_release.body: # raylib 6.2 release notes After almost 6 months since latest raylib release, here it is a new installment of the library. It was supposed to be just a patch version to address an issue with CMake build system but it took way longer than expected and included +300 changes and improvements. Some numbers for this release: - **~100** closed issues (for a TOTAL of **+2240**!) - **+500** commits since previous RELEASE (for a TOTAL of **+10280**!) - **+20** new functions ADDED to raylib API (for a TOTAL of **619**!) - **+10** new examples to learn from (for a TOTAL of **+225**!) - **+100** new contributors (for a TOTAL of **+950**!) Highlights for `raylib 6.2`: - **Code gardening**: A lot of work has been done to improve small library details, for consistency and coherence. Many comments have been reviewed, some function parameters have been renamed with more clear naming, some pointers reviewed for const-correctness, functions reordered in the API for more clarity and also several functions have been completely redesigned. - **REDESIGNED: Image drawing API more alignment with Screen drawing API**: Image API has been reviewed to be aligned with Texture API, now most Texture-based functions (GPU accelerated) have a counter-part to work over Image structures (CPU), also following same parameters order.
